$comment: Single source of server.properties field metadata. Read by the Rust backend (include_str!) and the frontend demo backend. Each key is owned by exactly one scope.

fields.label: World folder
fields.description: Folder name on disk. Taken from the world asset — change it by renaming the world.

fields.label: World seed
fields.description: Used only the first time the world generates.

fields.label: World type
fields.description: Generation preset applied to a brand new world.

fields.label: Generate structures
fields.description: Villages, strongholds, monuments and bastions.

fields.label: World border
fields.description: Diameter of the world border in blocks.

fields.label: Allow Nether
fields.description: Create and permit travel to this world’s Nether.

fields.label: Difficulty
fields.description: Hostile mob damage, hunger and health regen.

fields.label: Default gamemode
fields.description: Game mode given to players the first time they join.

fields.label: Hardcore
fields.description: Deaths ban the player and lock the world in spectator mode.

fields.label: Force gamemode
fields.description: Reset every join to the default gamemode instead of restoring the last one.

fields.label: Player vs player
fields.description: Players may damage each other.

fields.label: Allow flight
fields.description: Tolerate clients that fly (Creative, elytra, modded). Off can trigger anticheat kicks.

fields.label: Command blocks
fields.description: Allow command blocks to execute commands.

fields.label: Spawn protection
fields.description: Radius around spawn where only ops may break blocks. 0 turns it off.

fields.label: Hostile mobs
fields.description: Hostile mobs spawn in the dark.

fields.label: NPCs
fields.description: Villagers and other NPCs spawn naturally.

fields.label: Enabled data packs
fields.description: Data packs enabled the first time the world loads.

fields.label: Disabled data packs
fields.description: Data packs shipped in the world folder but left off.

fields.label: Message of the day
fields.description: Shown in the multiplayer list. Supports § colour codes.

fields.label: Max players
fields.description: Player slots advertised in the server list ping. Does not kick anyone already online.

fields.label: Online mode
fields.description: Authenticate names against Mojang sessions. Disable only when a proxy handles auth.

fields.label: Whitelist
fields.description: Only whitelisted players may join. Manage the list in the Players tab.

fields.label: Enforce whitelist
fields.description: Kick players who are removed from the whitelist while online.

fields.label: Hide player list
fields.description: Do not reveal the online player list to server list pings.

fields.label: Idle timeout
fields.description: Kick players idle for this long. 0 never kicks.

fields.label: Query protocol
fields.description: Answer GameSpy4 query pings on the query port (used by server list scrapers).

fields.label: Query port
fields.description: UDP port for the query protocol. Set on the instance.

fields.label: View distance
fields.description: Chunks sent to each client. The heaviest lever for CPU and bandwidth.

fields.label: Simulation distance
fields.description: Chunks where mobs, crops and redstone actually tick.

fields.label: Tick watchdog
fields.description: Warn when one tick runs longer than this. -1 disables the watchdog.

fields.label: Chained updates
fields.description: Cap on block updates per tick, limits piston and observer loops.

fields.label: Compression threshold
fields.description: Compress packets larger than this. 0 disables compression.

fields.label: Sync chunk writes
fields.description: Flush chunks to disk synchronously. Faster off, safer on.

fields.label: Native transport
fields.description: Linux only: use epoll for lower latency networking.

fields.label: Rate limit
fields.description: Drop packets from clients sending faster than this. 0 disables it.

fields.label: Broadcast range
fields.description: How far entity updates reach clients. 100 matches the vanilla view radius.

fields.label: Enable RCON
fields.description: Expose RCON so Lodestone can send commands and read responses. Always on: Lodestone uses RCON for the console, player actions and safe backups.

fields.label: RCON port
fields.description: Published on loopback only — never reachable from the internet. Published on 127.0.0.1 only. Change it on the instance.

fields.label: RCON password
fields.description: Shared with Lodestone and stored in SQLite. Never written to logs. Generated per instance and never shown.

fields.label: Broadcast RCON commands
fields.description: Show commands sent over RCON to online ops.

fields.label: Broadcast console commands
fields.description: Show console commands to online ops.

fields.label: Chat signing
fields.description: Enforce Mojang chat signing. Unsigned messages are rejected.

fields.label: Block proxies
fields.description: Reject connections from known proxy IP ranges.

fields.label: Honour proxy IPs
fields.description: Trust forwarded IPs from a proxy sitting in front of the server.

fields.label: Log player IPs
fields.description: Write connecting addresses into the log file.

fields.label: JMX monitoring
fields.description: Expose JVM metrics on localhost:9010.

fields.label: Track random splits
fields.description: Log RNG splits so bug reports can be reproduced.

fields.label: Text filtering config
fields.description: File used to filter chat text. Blank disables filtering.

fields.label: Bug report link
fields.description: Shown to players when they file a crash report.

fields.label: Function permission level
fields.description: Permission level for functions and command block functions.

fields.label: Op permission level
fields.description: Permission level granted when a player is made op in game.

fields.label: Require resource pack
fields.description: Kick players who decline the resource pack.

fields.label: Resource pack URL
fields.description: HTTPS URL of the pack pushed to clients on join.

fields.label: Resource pack prompt
fields.description: Message shown when asking players to download the pack.

fields.label: Resource pack SHA-1
fields.description: Hash of the pack. Required for modern clients to accept it.

fields.label: Server port
fields.description: TCP port players connect to. Mapped into the container. Set on the instance; mapped into the container.

fields.label: Bind address
fields.description: Interface the server binds to. Leave blank to bind every interface. Containers always bind every interface; the published port decides exposure.
